name: LocalOps Linux Command Knowledge Base
description: Safe, structured diagnostic capabilities for common Linux troubleshooting problems.

uptime.description: Display system uptime and load average
use_when: The user reports high system load
The agent needs to investigate current system load

-p.description: Show uptime in pretty human-readable format

-s.description: Show system up since date and time

free.description: Display RAM and swap memory usage
use_when: The user reports high memory usage
The agent needs to investigate RAM pressure
The agent needs to investigate swap usage

-h.description: Display memory sizes in human-readable units

-t.description: Display a line showing the total of RAM + swap

-w.description: Wide mode: separates buffers and cache columns

use_when: The user reports low disk space
The user reports that storage is full
The agent needs to investigate filesystem capacity

-h.description: Display disk sizes in human-readable units

-i.description: List inode information instead of block usage

-T.description: Print filesystem type (e.g. ext4, btrfs, tmpfs)

--total.description: Produce a grand total line at the bottom

use_when: The user reports high CPU usage
The user reports high memory usage
The agent needs to identify resource-heavy processes

aux.description: Show processes from all users in a user-oriented format

-ef.description: Standard full-format process listing showing UID, PID, PPID

ax.description: List all processes without terminal control

use_when: The user wants to inspect files
The agent needs to inspect a directory
The agent needs to verify whether files exist

-h.description: Display file sizes in human-readable units

-lh.description: Long listing with human readable sizes

id.description: Show current user and group IDs

-a.description: List all block devices including RAM disks

-m.description: Output device permissions, owner, and group permissions

-d.description: Do not print slave partitions (disk level only)

-l.description: List format instead of hierarchical tree

-D.description: Display df-style filesystem size and utilization columns

-a.description: List all filesystems including pseudo filesystems

systemctl.description: List failed system services without changing them

is-system-running.description: Query overall operational state of systemd manager

journalctl.description: Show recent current-boot errors; logs may contain private information
use_when: system errors, service errors, application crashes

-xe.description: Show catalog explanations and jump to end

neigh.description: Inspect ARP / neighbor cache table for subnet MAC mappings

nmcli.description: Inspect NetworkManager device and active connection status

dns.description: Show configured DNS servers for all interfaces

domain.description: Show search domains configured for all interfaces

statistics.description: Display DNS transaction statistics and cache metrics

pactl.description: Inspect audio server and audio devices

timedatectl.description: Inspect time zone and clock synchronization
use_when: wrong system time or time zone

timesync-status.description: Show NTP network time synchronization status and server offset

--print-architecture.description: Print target CPU architecture for dpkg packages

apt-get.description: Check package dependency consistency without installing packages

check.description: Check dependencies without installing or removing packages

-s.description: Simulate operation without altering package state

apt.description: List upgradable packages without applying upgrades

--installed.description: Filter listing to packages currently installed on the system

flatpak.description: List installed Flatpak apps and runtimes

lspci.description: List PCI hardware when pciutils is installed

-k.description: Show kernel drivers and modules handling each device

-nn.description: Show numeric vendor and device codes

lsusb.description: List USB hardware when usbutils is installed

-t.description: Dump physical USB device hierarchy as a tree

sensors.description: Inspect hardware temperature sensors, voltages, and fan speeds

acpi.description: Show battery, thermal, and AC adapter status

-V.description: Show all available ACPI device information

-i.description: Show battery capacity and design specifications

vmstat.description: Display virtual memory, swap activity, I/O, and CPU statistics

-m.description: Display kernel slab allocator memory cache statistics

iostat.description: Display CPU and storage device I/O statistics

-z.description: Omit output for any devices with zero activity

ss.description: Inspect network sockets, connections, and listening ports

-tuln.description: Display listening TCP and UDP sockets without name resolution

-tulpn.description: Display listening TCP/UDP sockets with process names

-tlpn.description: Display listening TCP sockets with process names

-tln.description: Display listening TCP sockets without resolving names

-tun.description: Display TCP and UDP sockets without resolving names

lscpu.description: Display CPU architecture, cores, sockets, frequency, and cache information

mpstat.description: Display per-processor and multi-CPU core utilization

lsmod.description: Show the status of modules in the Linux kernel

lsb_release.description: Display Linux Standard Base and Ubuntu/Debian distribution release information

top.description: Batch snapshot of CPU utilization, memory pressure, and top process rankings

-b.description: Run in batch mode suitable for output capture

systemd-analyze.description: Analyze Linux system boot-up performance and slowest startup services

time.description: Display total time spent in kernel, initrd, and userspace boot

blame.description: Print list of running units ordered by the time each took to initialize

critical-chain.description: Print time-critical chain of systemd units delaying system boot

hostnamectl.description: Query system hostname, operating system release, machine ID, and architecture

status.description: Display system identity, operating system name, kernel release, and CPU architecture

networkctl.description: Query systemd-networkd network link states, operational carriers, and address configurations

status.description: Display operational status, IP addresses, gateway, and carrier for network interfaces

list.description: List all network links with operational and setup states

localectl.description: Query system locale, keyboard mapping, and character set configuration

status.description: Display current system locale and console/X11 keyboard layout
